data.title: bn-1ld: Allow loopback aliases in console serve Host validation

data.reason: Security/correctness review approved. Full diff and serve.rs path inspected: requested port is rejected before host-alias equivalence, and equivalence is limited to exact localhost/localhost. or IpAddr::is_loopback; unrelated DNS names and non-loopback literals remain rejected. Focused unit/integration tests passed. Independent TCP matrix accepted localhost, localhost., 127/8 aliases, and ::1; attacker.example, localhost.attacker.example, 192.0.2.4, and a wrong-port localhost authority returned 421 without cart source.
